title: Courtesy Transportation Agreements Balances: Payment, Store-Caused Charge Waivers and Closing
content:
Cashier's office rule on settling the balance of an agreement under the Courtesy Transportation Agreements and closing it.

## The balance of an agreement

The balance is the amount the customer owes on one loaner agreement. Charges increase it; waivers and payments reduce it.

## Rule

1. **When the balance is paid.** Retail balances are paid at return. A Fleet Replacement Unit balance is due the program's payment-due days, in calendar days, after return.
2. **Store-caused charges.** A charge caused by the store (a loaner issued below the fuel level recorded, a late return because the store had not finished the repair by the due date it set) is waived in full by one waiver entry pointing at it.
3. **Closing.** An agreement is closed only when it is in returned status and its balance is 0.00.

Clause 3 is read from the agreement record before closing: the status and the balance shown on that same agreement decide it. Closing records the closing date and moves the agreement from returned status to closed status, once every charge on it is settled.

## Clause 3 as a truth table

| Status of the agreement | Balance | May be closed |
|---|---|---|
| Out | Any amount | No |
| Returned | 0.00 | Yes |
| Returned | Above 0.00 | No |

## Clause 2 in practice: hypothetical illustration

A fuel charge of 31.00 posted on an agreement whose loaner was issued below the fuel level recorded is a charge caused by the store. It is waived in full by one waiver entry of 31.00 pointing at that fuel charge, which reduces the balance by 31.00. Likewise, a late return charge posted because the store had not finished the repair by the due date it set is waived in full by one waiver entry pointing at that late return charge. The amount of 31.00 is invented for the example.

## Hypothetical settlement sequence on one retail agreement

| Entry | Effect on the balance | Balance after |
|---|---|---|
| Charges posted at return totalling 120.00 | Increase | 120.00 |
| A store-caused charge of 20.00 waived in full | Decrease | 100.00 |
| Payment of 100.00 at return | Decrease | 0.00 |

With the agreement in returned status and the balance at 0.00, the agreement may be closed. The amounts are invented for the example.
